Explanation: The core value exchanged is a stay in an entire vacation home that the guest or group has to itself.
Vrbo, part of Expedia Group, runs the vacation-rental marketplace, booking flow, payment layer, reviews and host tools.
Vrbo has to make whole vacation homes easy to find, compare, book and trust across many countries.
More useful homes attract more travelers, while Expedia Group's wider travel ecosystem can bring repeat demand through One Key.
Vrbo must manage listing accuracy, cancellations, local rental laws, disputes, fraud and uneven property quality without owning the homes.
Vrbo coordinates search, reservation, payment, host payout, messaging, reviews and customer support around the stay.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Search / Pay — Travelers bring demand to Vrbo, search the whole-home inventory and pay through the platform when they book. | → Consumer · Homes / Support — Vrbo gives travelers searchable whole-home listings, transparent pricing, booking tools, messaging, reviews and support. | ← Provider · Home / Rates — Hosts make an entire property available by publishing the home, rates, dates, rules and amenities. | → Provider · Bookings / Pay — Vrbo brings traveler demand to hosts, manages the reservation and payment flow, and sends the host payout after applicable fees. | ← Partner · Cover / Claims — Insurance partners support liability and protection programs connected with eligible Vrbo stays.

Explanation: Vrbo's defining supply rule is that listings are entire homes rather than private rooms or shared living spaces.
Vrbo attracts travelers through its brand, app and website and can also participate in Expedia Group's One Key loyalty ecosystem.
Vrbo runs search and ranking, booking and payment flows, support, reviews, host tooling and marketplace enforcement.
Core resources include vacation-home supply, traveler demand, listing and review data, booking technology, payments and Expedia Group distribution.
Vrbo is especially oriented toward families and groups that want a private vacation home with space to stay together.
Travelers want one private place that fits their destination, dates, group size, budget and amenities.
Whole-home rentals give groups private bedrooms, shared living space, kitchens and other residential amenities without sharing the home with strangers.
Travelers can worry about total price, cancellations, inaccurate listings, cleanliness and whether the property will match expectations.
Travelers search, compare, book and pay through Vrbo, then stay and can review the property afterward.

Explanation: Travelers filter by destination, dates, group size, bedrooms, amenities, property type, price and reviews.
Travelers use Vrbo's app and website, with the same account participating in One Key where eligible.
Travelers search, compare homes, message hosts when needed, book, stay and review the experience.
Travelers bring trip dates, destination, group size, budget, payment information and reviews from past stays.
Supply comes from homeowners and professional property managers that list entire vacation homes on Vrbo.
Hosts want to earn income from a vacation property while controlling availability, rates, house rules and guest requirements.
Vrbo gives hosts access to traveler demand, Expedia Group distribution, booking tools and payment processing.
Hosts face property damage, cancellations, local regulations, taxes, cleaning work, vacancies and guest disputes.
Hosts publish a whole-home listing, set rates and availability, accept bookings, provide the stay and receive payouts.

Explanation: Vrbo's marketplace focuses on entire homes; private rooms and shared living spaces are outside the core listing model.
Hosts use the Vrbo dashboard, app, calendar, pricing tools, messaging, payout settings and connectivity software.
Hosts describe the property, manage rates and availability, communicate with guests, prepare the home and maintain quality.
Hosts contribute the vacation home itself, available dates, property information, local knowledge and hosting work.

Vrbo's large booking network creates recurring travel and property-risk volume for insurance partners.
Insurers must price and manage claims, fraud, exclusions and different legal conditions across markets.

Coverage is connected to eligible Vrbo bookings and protection programs rather than purchased as a separate marketplace listing.
Insurance partners underwrite eligible risk, support claims handling and pay covered losses according to policy terms.
